story_zh: 小李本来以为爱情是浪漫的，但他发现真正的爱情需要理解、尊重和耐心。他曾经粗心，犯过错误，让女友失望。不过，他勇敢道歉，坚持改正缺点。现在他明白：爱情不仅是感觉，更是责任。即使有烦恼，也要积极面对。这让他感觉真正幸福。
story_pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ běnlái yǐwéi àiqíng shì làngmàn de, dàn tā fāxiàn zhēnzhèng de àiqíng xūyào lǐjiě, zūnzhòng hé nàixīn. Tā céngjīng cūxīn, fànguò cuòwù, ràng nǚyǒu shīwàng. Bùguò, tā yǒnggǎn dàoqiàn, jiānchí gǎizhèng quēdiǎn. Xiànzài tā míngbái: àiqíng bùjǐn shì gǎnjué, gèng shì zérèn. Jíshǐ yǒu fánnǎo, yě yào jījí miànduì. Zhè ràng tā gǎnjué zhēnzhèng xìngfú.
story_en: Xiao Li originally thought love was romantic, but he discovered that true love requires understanding, respect, and patience. He used to be careless, made mistakes, and disappointed his girlfriend. However, he bravely apologized and persisted in correcting his shortcomings. Now he understands: love is not only a feeling but also a responsibility. Even if there are troubles, one must face them positively. This makes him feel truly happy.
